# Project Overview

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS - Current state

### Purpose

Rem Soft Projeto Padrao provides a Laravel and Livewire application shell for authenticated platform management, user and role administration, support operations, and shared lookup services (`README.md`, `routes/web.php`, `routes/admin.php`).

### Business problem

- Centralizes user types, roles, permissions, and protected administrative access (`app/Models/User.php`, `app/Models/Role.php`, `app/Http/Middleware/EnsureUserCanAccessAdminArea.php`).
- Gives support staff an audited interface for error triage and controlled Artisan command execution (`routes/admin.php`, `app/Models/SystemErrorAlert.php`, `app/Models/CommandExecution.php`).
- Supplies reusable user, role, state, postal-code, and company lookups (`routes/search.php`, `app/Services/ViaCep/ViaCepService.php`, `app/Services/Cnpj/CnpjService.php`).

### Consumers and integrations

| System/Role | Entry point | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Authenticated user | `/dashboard`, `/perfil` | Dashboard and profile management |
| Admin-area user | `/admin/*` | User, role, error-alert, and command-execution operations |
| Livewire/select clients | `/search/users`, `/search/roles`, `/search/states` | Paginated lookup data |
| Queue workers | Horizon Redis supervisors | Notifications, Discord alerts, and long-running Artisan commands |
| External providers | Discord, ViaCEP, CNPJ service, Brevo, S3 | Alerts, lookup data, email, and media storage |

### Macro flow

1. `public/index.php` boots the application through `bootstrap/app.php`.
2. `routes/web.php` registers authentication, search, and admin route groups.
3. Laravel middleware authenticates users and redirects admin-capable user types to the admin dashboard.
4. Controllers or Livewire components validate and authorize input, then call Actions, Brain Actions, services, or Eloquent models.
5. Database-backed state is persisted through Eloquent; asynchronous work is dispatched to configured queues.
6. Unhandled reportable failures are persisted, throttled by fingerprint, and optionally sent to Discord.

### Out of scope

- `routes/api.php` is present but is not registered in `bootstrap/app.php`; the application has no active `/api` route group.
- The repository configures clients for external services but does not implement those external systems.
